HADESTOWN (2026)
movie - musical

August 21, 2026

really amazing musical and also?? an absolutely beautifully shot movie. the music was phenomenal, plus it was played live on stage in the back??? they must’ve been having a great time. and it was a sweet mix of blues and folk and jazz, i need to listen to it again on spotify. the story itself really hit me halfway through, and had such a beautiful, bittersweet message as a whole. and the lighting. THE LIGHTING. never had i had so much respect for tech theater. except for maybe phantom.

i’d been waiting to see this musical for 4 years now, abstaining from any exposure to the music or play itself the whole time, and i’m so happy i waited because i got to see it with THE friend who had been telling me to see it with them the whole time.
